name: dynamics_wording_v1
purpose: Prospective paired check of a confirmed mismatch between deterministic environment dynamics and the original slippery-movement description. Correctness repair, not a new policy or altered task dynamics.
constant: Base b0 weights, vision observations, system examples enabled, is_slippery=false/slip_prob=0,5 actions/turn, all quality/semantic gates unchanged. Only accurate_dynamics_prompt differs. Distill=self, cold_start=false, immutable empty library in both arms; no admissions/updates/checkpoints.
design: All32 seeds fixed before model calls, alternating arm order by seed index. Full5-turn episodes, not first-turn probes. No replacement/retry/early success stop. Report canonical-board duplicate/overlap counts, not just distinct seeds.
lead_gate: A performance lead requires at least4 paired success improvements, at most1 success regression, and at least2 net additional quality-eligible successes. No significance or general performance claim from this small run. Correctness of the description is distinct from meeting this performance gate.
stop: Exactly64 episodes maximum/384 calls,30min/500MB. Repairs share first receipt and may not rerun completed episodes. No training or deletion of old checkpoints. If gate fails, close this prompt branch and reconsider mainline training/skill feedback under current scientific/storage gates; do not expand this experiment.
